newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PDVSA's Graf sees continued expansion in 1997.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA's Graf sees continued expansion in 1997.

text.p: After another year of improved output and profits Venezuela's state-run Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) foresees another year of strong growth in 1997, PDVSA vice-President Claus Graf said Friday.
"1997 is going to be another year of growth for the industry," Graf told a breakfast meeting with journalists.
Graf said that in 1996, "we have met and even bettered all of our production goals."
Graf refused to put a figure on current output and would say only that exports in 1997 would be "a little more than we exported this year."
According to PDVSA figures obtained recently by Reuters the company exported 2.645 million barrels per day in the first half of 1996.
Venezuela's production quota as a member of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) is 2.359 million barrels per day.
